div.head: Ine 76
div.ab: {CXX} Gif hwa oðres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sie sio mægbot ⁊ sio manbot gelic; weaxe sio bot be ðam were, swa ilce swa sio monbot deð þe þam hlaforde sceal.

If someone slays another person’s godson or his godfather, let the man-price [paid] to the [religious] kinsman be equal [to that paid] to the lord; the price [paid the kinsman] shall increase according to the wer, just as does the man-price owed to the lord.

If anyone slays the godson or the godfather of another, the sum to be paid as compensation to a man who has entered into a relationship of this kind shall be equal to the amount paid to the dead man's lord. The amount of compensation shall increase according to the wergeld, just as is the case with compensation due to a man's lord.
Gif hwa oðres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sy seo mægbot ⁊ seo manbot gelic; weaxe seo bot be þam were, swa ilce swa seo monbot deþ þe ðam hlaforde sceal.
